name: Hidaka (Kōchi, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Hidaka village emblem in white: a winged device above a ring enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hidaka, a village in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Hidaka village emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a disc
